description: Inspect blocks to reveal concealed dispatch targets; discoveries stay visible. After RUN, heat and manually weld each moving contact. Contacts advance one fixed 100 ms physics step after each deliberate input and hold between inputs. Full uses probe drags; simplified uses probe selection, aiming, and WELD TOOL. Flags and feedback affect later routes. Wrong edges, missed welds, empty buffers, or incomplete certification fail.
